# netbox_virtual_device_context (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/virtualdevicecontext/):

> A virtual device context (VDC) is a logical partition of a device, with its own interfaces and addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_device_context" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
  status    = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String) One of [active, planned, offline].

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `identifier` (Number)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `primary_ip4_id` (Number)
- `primary_ip6_id` (Number)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
